title: Abelian sheaves on a topological space have functorial injective embeddings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the category of abelian sheaves on a topological space has enough injectives and in fact functorial injective embeddings (statement lines 655-660). The proof is a complete construction: for an abelian group a functorial embedding into an injective group is chosen, and a sheaf is mapped into the sheaf whose sections are the products over the points of the chosen injective groups at the stalks, which is a product of skyscraper sheaves (proof lines 662-690); the map is injective because it is injective on stalks, and the target is injective because products of injective objects are injective, so the assignment is a functorial injective embedding (proof lines 690-699). The non-formal content is the skyscraper construction and the injectivity check. The claim is H2.
